summary: FD_TC_222_3rd Party � Family/Friend � OTP Passed � Claim Allowed (Automated)
title: 3rd Party � Family/Friend � OTP Passed � Claim Allowed (Automated)
description:
Validates that when a family member or friend submits a claim on behalf of a passenger and successfully passes OTP authentication, the system allows them to proceed with the claim through the automated flow.

Prerequisites:
Third-party caller type: Parent/Guardian/Family/Friend. OTP authentication available. Passenger's contact info on file for OTP.
